html: II. אבה (perhaps at least formally justified as stem of אָב (cstr. אֲבִי), so Thes (cf. infr.), but existence & meaning wholly dub.; as real √ BaZMG 1887, 609 ff. Ol§ 123 c; according to DlW p. 22 אבה Assyrian abû = decide, אָב = he who decides; Thes (so RobGes NöZMG xl, 737 & cf. Sta§ 186 al.) makes אָב nom. prim. bilit., imitating infant’s speech cf. πάππας, pappa, papa (cf. Ew§ 106 a); also Assyrian bab JenZA 1886, 404).
